svg.title: Ornament signatures: six recorded references
svg.desc: Six cardinal centerline constructions and their connected white regions. Green regions open at the top; orange regions at the bottom.
svg.text: Recorded centerlines. Green: opens at top. Orange: opens at bottom. Two periods per panel.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: Interlocking fret: 2 repeats
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Recorded centerline geometry. Optional layers expose connected whitespace, pen direction, and recorded rotation centers. Repeated crop edges continue into neighboring copies.
